_instructions.what: The `experiments/paper/constants.json` entries stream E2h asks the integrator to add. They are handed over in this file rather than spliced in, because constants.json is edited by one integrator and was in flight from two other streams during this session.
_instructions.how: Merge `fillable_now` and `shaped_nulls` into constants.json's `constants` object. `fillable_now` carries real values derived from already-frozen keys and should pass `experiments/paper/check.py` as-is (add the `chk` lines in `check_lines`). `shaped_nulls` are null-with-a-note placeholders that the H200 session fills from `experiments/e2/out/constants_rows.json`, which `sh e2/run.sh ladder` emits in exactly this shape.
_instructions.replaces: `tok_s.unproved_8b_h200` currently holds a single null. Replace its note with `pointer_rewrite` below; the value stays null forever.
_instructions.provenance: Re-render notes/provenance.md (`uv run python experiments/paper/render_provenance.py --update`) after merging.

tok_s.unproved_8b_h200.note: POINTER, not a number. E2h shaped this into the rows below (`tok_s.unproved_8b_h200.<backend>.c<ctx>.<arm>`), because 'the unproved rate' is not one number: two backends x two contexts x {batch-1 decode-only, batch-1 all-positions (E11), batched peak}. Never quote this key; quote a row. The harness that fills them is `experiments/e2/decode_bench.py`, the table is `experiments/e2/ladder.py`, and `sh e2/run.sh ladder` emits the filled rows into `experiments/e2/out/constants_rows.json`.

usd_per_mtok.proved_8b.c4096.commit.note: 33 chunks, head included. Needs no E2 measurement -- both inputs are frozen. The UNPROVED counterpart is blocked on the box session.

usd_per_mtok.proved_8b.c4096.whole.note: 33 chunks, head included. THE headline $/Mtok cell at the honest per-chunk boundary. Excludes the witness read -- that is `loop_secs`, one row down and CHEAPER, because the pipelined loop overlaps the build with the prove (see rate.h200.c4096.loop_layers32).

usd_per_mtok.proved_8b.c4096.loop.note: HEADLESS (32 layer chunks, no lm_head): this denominator flatters us against a whole-model numerator and must be printed with that label. 8.277 tok/s.

baseline.e2h_protocol.note: not yet measured -- E2h box session. The protocol every `tok_s.unproved_8b_h200.*` row is produced by: greedy, EOS suppressed, exactly `spec.decoded_tokens` new tokens on a prompt of exactly C tokens, prompts distinct per batch element (stride 1013 through experiments/text.txt), prefix caching OFF, warmup outside the timed region. TTFT from a max_new_tokens=1 call, total from the 512-token call, decode seconds by SUBTRACTION. Two counting conventions come out of the same run: `.b1` excludes prefill (matching `scope.prefill_status` -- the prompt is declared, not proven) and `.b1_e11` counts every position of the concatenated pass. Identical protocol on both backends, so hf-vs-vllm is engine and nothing else.

tok_s.unproved_8b_h200.hf.c4096.b1.note: not yet measured -- E2h box session. Single-stream greedy decode, batch 1, 512 new tokens after a 4096-token prompt, bf16, `transformers.generate()`. Prefill EXCLUDED: rate is 511/(total - TTFT). The NAIVE baseline -- what a non-specialist gets. Quoting ONLY this would flatter us, which is the error we accuse fn. 170 of.

tok_s.unproved_8b_h200.hf.c16384.b1.note: not yet measured -- E2h box session. As the C=4096 row, 16384-token prompt. A ratio taken across two different contexts is meaningless, so this exists to keep the C=16K ladder honest.

tok_s.unproved_8b_h200.vllm.c4096.b1.note: not yet measured -- E2h box session. THE like-for-like denominator for the single-stream sentence of notes/final-framing.md section 4 (today: '~125-200 unproved 8B', a GUESS). Production engine, batch 1, prefix caching OFF, greedy, EOS suppressed, 512 tokens. The ladder takes the FASTER of the two backends, which is the conservative direction: a faster denominator makes the reported overhead LARGER.

tok_s.unproved_8b_h200.vllm.c16384.b1.note: not yet measured -- E2h box session.

tok_s.unproved_8b_h200.hf.c4096.b1_e11.note: not yet measured -- E2h box session. THE E11 COUNTING CONVENTION, from the same run as the `.b1` row: (4096 + 512) positions over the whole wall of the concatenated pass, prefill INCLUDED. This is how DeepProve's TPM counts and how our own statement must count once E11 proves the prompt. It is ~9x the decode-only rate at C=4K, so the E11 overhead multiple is much larger -- the fork in the denominator is real and must not be collapsed.

tok_s.unproved_8b_h200.vllm.c4096.batche.note: not yet measured -- E2h box session. AGGREGATE decode rate at the best batch of the sweep; the sweep stops itself at OOM and records where. This is the denominator the 500,000x claim actually uses (its 668 tok/s is an optimized batched figure), and it is NOT a latency comparison -- it feeds $/token only. NOTE for vLLM: a nominal batch is OFFERED concurrency; the engine may serve it in waves. The aggregate rate is still correct.
